title: POST /guard contract (spec_version 1.0)
description: Source: competition/SPEC.md §3, §5 (authoritative). Request is parsed leniently (unknown fields allowed); response is strict for scored fields (exact lowercase enum values). 'output' is required whenever the request has a candidate_answer key, even an empty string (cross-document rule, enforced in tests, not here). If messages (and candidate_answer) can be read, the server judges; otherwise it returns the default 200 response (PRD v6 GR-09), never FastAPI's 422 (it echoes input). Only an auth failure is non-200. decision is derived from category (ADR-0012).

messages.description: Full history. First and last items are role=user (SPEC §3).

decision.description: block iff category is jailbreak_injection, harmful_content, academic_dishonesty or off_topic (ADR-0012).

unsupported.description: Verbatim substrings of candidate_answer (grader compares a char multiset after NFKC, lowercase, whitespace/punctuation removal). Scored independently of grounded; grounded=false with [] is allowed (ADR-0014).

category.description: Any string; not scored (SPEC §5). We copy input.category (ADR-0009).
